legend: The board has got a painted tree graph, consisting of n nodes. Let us remind you that a non-directed graph is called a tree if it is connected and doesn't contain any cycles.

Each node of the graph is painted black or white in such a manner that there aren't two nodes of the same color, connected by an edge. Each edge contains its value written on it as a non-negative integer.

A bad boy Vasya came up to the board and wrote number sv near each node v — the sum of values of all edges that are incident to this node. Then Vasya removed the edges and their values from the board.
Your task is to restore the original tree by the node colors and numbers sv.
input: The first line of the input contains a single integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 105) — the number of nodes in the tree. Next n lines contain pairs of space-separated integers ci, si (0 ≤ ci ≤ 1, 0 ≤ si ≤ 109), where ci stands for the color of the i-th vertex (0 is for white, 1 is for black), and si represents the sum of values of the edges that are incident to the i-th vertex of the tree that is painted on the board.
output: Print the description of n - 1 edges of the tree graph. Each description is a group of three integers vi, ui, wi (1 ≤ vi, ui ≤ n, vi ≠ ui, 0 ≤ wi ≤ 109), where vi and ui — are the numbers of the nodes that are connected by the i-th edge, and wi is its value. Note that the following condition must fulfill cvi ≠ cui.

It is guaranteed that for any input data there exists at least one graph that meets these data. If there are multiple solutions, print any of them. You are allowed to print the edges in any order. As you print the numbers, separate them with spaces.

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 n（2 ≤ n ≤ 10^5），表示树中的节点数。接下来的 n 行包含两个以空格分隔的整数 c_i、s_i（0 ≤ c_i ≤ 1，0 ≤ s_i ≤ 10^9），其中 c_i 表示第 i 个顶点的颜色（0 表示白色，1 表示黑色），s_i 表示黑板上所画的树中与第 i 个顶点相连的所有边的权值之和。

output.ai: 输出树图中 n - 1 条边的描述。每条边的描述由三个整数 v_i、u_i、w_i 组成（1 ≤ v_i、u_i ≤ n，v_i ≠ u_i，0 ≤ w_i ≤ 10^9），其中 v_i 和 u_i 是第 i 条边所连接的节点编号，w_i 是该边的权值。注意，必须满足条件 c_{v_i} ≠ c_{u_i}。
保证对于任意输入数据，至少存在一个满足这些数据的图。如果有多个解，输出任意一个即可。你可以按任意顺序输出这些边。输出数字时，请使用空格分隔。

legend.ai: 棋盘上有一张由 n 个节点组成的树图。提醒一下，如果一个无向图是连通的且不包含任何环，那么它就被称为树。
图中的每个节点都被涂成黑色或白色，并且不存在两个颜色相同且由一条边相连的节点。每条边上都写有一个非负整数作为其权值。
一个名叫 Vasya 的坏男孩来到棋盘旁，在每个节点 v 附近写下数字 s_v——与该节点相连的所有边的权值之和。然后 Vasya 从棋盘上擦去了这些边及其权值。
你的任务是根据节点的颜色和数字 s_v 还原原来的树。
